name.zh: 織布長輩：把苧麻線捲好
name.en: Weaving elder: wind the ramie thread

steps.text: 紅頭的織布長輩請族女幫忙捲線
steps.textEn: The Imorod weaving elder asks the Tao woman to help wind thread

lines.zh: 妳處理過苧麻了，現在來學捲線。線捲得好，布才織得平。
lines.en: You've prepared ramie, so now learn to wind thread. Wind it well and the cloth weaves flat.

lines.zh: 飛魚季的時候我們不織布，所以冬天要多做一點。
lines.en: We don't weave during flying fish season, so we do more in winter.

steps.text: 族女在紅頭的簷廊下，把苧麻線一圈一圈捲好
steps.textEn: Under the Imorod porch, the Tao woman winds the ramie thread round and round

lines.zh: 一圈、兩圈……手要放鬆，線才不會斷。
lines.en: One turn, two… keep your hands relaxed so the thread doesn't snap.

steps.text: 把捲好的線交給織布長輩
steps.textEn: Give the wound thread to the weaving elder

lines.zh: 捲得很漂亮。這一捲給妳留著，以後用得到。
lines.en: Beautifully wound. Keep this roll — you'll need it later.

hint.zh: 冬天紅頭的織布長輩需要人幫忙捲苧麻線。
hint.en: In winter, the Imorod weaving elder needs help winding ramie thread.

name.en: Imorod elder: check the goats on the mountain

review: 「打獵」在達悟文化中的實際內容（羊群、山林）

text.unlock: 看到山上的羊（A4 解鎖）
text.unlockEn: Seeing the goats on the mountain (unlocks A4)

steps.text: 紅頭的長輩要族男一起上山看羊
steps.textEn: The Imorod elder wants the Tao man to come up the mountain to check the goats

lines.zh: 山上的事，男人要懂。今天上去看看我們家的羊（kagling）。
lines.en: Men need to know the mountain. Today we'll go see our family's goats (kagling).

lines.zh: 每家的羊，耳朵上的記號不一樣。不是自己家的，不要碰。
lines.en: Each family's goats have a different ear mark. If it's not yours, don't touch it.

steps.text: 族男跟長輩上紅頭山，數一數山坡上的羊
steps.textEn: The Tao man goes up Mt. Hongtou with the elder and counts the goats on the slope

lines.zh: 一、二、三……耳朵缺一角的是我們家的，總共五隻。
lines.en: One, two, three… the ones with a notched ear are ours. Five in all.

lines.zh: 五隻，對。以後羊走丟了，你就知道去哪裡找。
lines.en: Five, that's right. Now if a goat goes missing, you'll know where to look.

hint.zh: 紅頭的長輩負責山上的事，族男可以跟他上山看羊。
hint.en: The Imorod elder looks after the mountain. The Tao man can go up with him to check the goats.
